explanation: The ability to think and act with knowledge, experience, understanding, and sound judgment.
The ability to evaluate situations or people in a wise and reasonable manner.
Training, instruction, or correction intended to teach and improve behavior.
The quality of being wise and insightful, often linked to skill in handling complex situations.
The principle of acting rightly and honestly, in line with moral and ethical standards.
The trait of being modest and not having excessive pride or self-confidence.
The way we communicate and express ourselves through language and words.
A close relationship between two or more people based on mutual devotion, trust, and support.
A conflict, disagreement, or quarrel between individuals or groups.
The manner in which one speaks, including word choice and tone, which can greatly affect how a message is received.
